title: Prior-odds adjustment for the probability of direction — pd.adjust
code: # From a vector of pd values pd_values <- c(H1 = 0.999, H2 = 0.946, H3 = 0.813, H4 = 0.763, H5 = 0.891, H6 = 0.987) pd.adjust(pd = pd_values, p0 = 0.4) #> Prior-odds adjustment for directional claims #>   m = 6, pi.max = 0.8584 #>   c = 0.975, c* = 0.9958 #>   direction = two.sided #>  #>       pd pd.adj #> H1 0.999 0.9940 #> H2 0.946 0.7430 #> H3 0.813 0.4177 #> H4 0.763 0.3469 #> H5 0.891 0.5742 #> H6 0.987 0.9261 #>  #> pd.adj: pd when the favored direction has prior probability 1 - pi.max.  # The same, giving pi.max directly pd.adjust(pd = pd_values, pi.max = 0.4^(1/6)) #> Prior-odds adjustment for directional claims #>   m = 6, pi.max = 0.8584 #>   c = 0.975, c* = 0.9958 #>   direction = two.sided #>  #>       pd pd.adj #> H1 0.999 0.9940 #> H2 0.946 0.7430 #> H3 0.813 0.4177 #> H4 0.763 0.3469 #> H5 0.891 0.5742 #> H6 0.987 0.9261 #>  #> pd.adj: pd when the favored direction has prior probability 1 - pi.max.  # Simulate draws Sigma <- matrix(0, nrow = 6, ncol = 6); diag(Sigma) <- 1 mu    <- c(1, -0.1, 0.8, 0, 2, 3) draws <- MASS::mvrnorm(n = 4000, mu = mu, Sigma = Sigma) colnames(draws) <- c("H1", "H2", "H3", "H4", "H5", "H6")  # From posterior draws pd.adjust(draws = draws, pi.max = 0.7, null.value = 0) #> Prior-odds adjustment for directional claims #>   m = 6, pi.max = 0.7 #>   c = 0.975, c* = 0.9891 #>   null value = 0, direction = two.sided #>  #>    median.est     pd pd.adj #> H1     0.9860 0.8358 0.6856 #> H2    -0.1175 0.5350 0.3302 #> H3     0.7761 0.7822 0.6062 #> H4    -0.0089 0.5030 0.3025 #> H5     1.9500 0.9762 0.9463 #> H6     2.9866 0.9995 0.9988 #>  #> pd.adj: pd when the favored direction has prior probability 1 - pi.max.  # Rows sorted by decreasing pd pd.adjust(draws = draws, pi.max = 0.7, null.value = 0, order = TRUE) #> Prior-odds adjustment for directional claims #>   m = 6, pi.max = 0.7 #>   c = 0.975, c* = 0.9891 #>   null value = 0, direction = two.sided #>  #>    median.est     pd pd.adj #> H6     2.9866 0.9995 0.9988 #> H5     1.9500 0.9762 0.9463 #> H1     0.9860 0.8358 0.6856 #> H3     0.7761 0.7822 0.6062 #> H2    -0.1175 0.5350 0.3302 #> H4    -0.0089 0.5030 0.3025 #>  #> pd.adj: pd when the favored direction has prior probability 1 - pi.max.  # Different directions and null values across parameters pd.adjust(draws = draws, pi.max = 0.6, null.value = c(0.2, 0, 0.2, 0, 0.5, 0.5),           direction = c("greater", "two.sided", "greater",           "two.sided", "greater", "greater")) #> Prior-odds adjustment for directional claims #>   m = 6, pi.max = 0.6 #>   c = 0.975, c* = 0.9832 #>  #>    median.est null.value     pd pd.adj direction #> H1     0.9860        0.2 0.7820 0.7051   greater #> H2    -0.1175        0.0 0.5350 0.4341 two.sided #> H3     0.7761        0.2 0.7230 0.6350   greater #> H4    -0.0089        0.0 0.5030 0.4029 two.sided #> H5     1.9500        0.5 0.9285 0.8965   greater #> H6     2.9866        0.5 0.9948 0.9921   greater #>  #> pd.adj: pd when the favored direction has prior probability 1 - pi.max.
